name: ISIC 2020 Challenge Dataset (SIIM-ISIC Melanoma Classification)
description: The official ISIC 2020 Challenge dataset comprising 44,108 dermoscopic images from 2,056 patients across three continents, paired with patient-level clinical metadata (age, sex, anatomical site) for melanoma classification. Safeguard notice: Designed for research and algorithmic benchmarking in skin lesion classification; non-commercial research use only; not for direct clinical patient management without specialist diagnosis.
